mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% (current level 2.04) predicts positive 20-day returns. The signal is always active as the FEDFUNDS series is continuously monitored, and the direction is fixed as positive when the rate is below 2.5% (which it currently is).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 255.0 (current level 256.358) predicts negative 20-day returns. The signal activates when CPIAUCSL crosses above 255.0, and the direction is negative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (current levels: FEDFUNDS=2.04, CPIAUCSL=256.358) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which leads to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising HOUST (housing starts) above 1300.0 predicts positive 20-day returns. The signal activates when UNRATE < 3.5 and HOUST > 1300.0.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 AND HOUST > 1300.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0, current level 109.92) predicts negative 60-day returns. The signal activates when INDPRO falls below 110.0.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1350.0, current level 1364.0) predict positive 5-day returns. The signal activates when HOUST exceeds 1350.0.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1350.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a strong demand regime (RSAFS > 500000.0, current level 526057.0), the level of HOUST (housing starts) predicts positive 60-day returns. The signal is active only when RSAFS > 500000.0, and the direction is fixed as positive.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 500000.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS > 150000.0, current level 151722.0) predicts positive 5-day returns. The signal activates when PAYEMS exceeds 150000.0.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000.0 (p-value < 0.05 for t-test against zero mean returns).
